note: Map layers for the console. pipeline/map_layers.py anchors each one on the console grid with GeoMapper (GeoTIFF: raster_to_matrix; CSV: CsvPointLayer + csv_to_matrices, one layer per numeric column). Paths are relative to this file. GeoTIFFs and CSVs dropped into this folder are picked up too. The three sources below are large raw files from Magnus's branch newData and are not in main; their exports in frontend/public/data/layers/ are committed and kept when the source is missing. Taken from Alex's branch navigation-view-/-hud on 2026-11-15; the radiation layer was left out (team decision: radiation is information only, and its uniform raster carries no spatial information).
